news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) a non-participant Thursday
news.desc: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: The veteran was unable to practice on Thursday due to the pair of injuries that he's currently managing. Terrance Ferguson (ankle) is also injured currently, so the Rams may have to lean on Tyler Higbee as their primary tight end against the Eagles this week.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Puka Nacua (groin) officially limited Thursday
news.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Some reports early in the day indicated that Nacua would be a full participant at Thursday's practice, but he ended up being limited for a second-straight day. There seems to be optimism surrounding his availability for Week 4, but fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next day or two to ensure that that will be the case.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
news.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.impact: Kinchens was able to participate in another practice on Thursday, still in a limited capacity. It looks like he's trending towards playing this week, which would be good news for Los Angeles' defense ahead of a matchup against the Eagles.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Julian Love (calf) limited Thursday
news.desc: Julian Love (calf) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: The veteran was able to log another limited practice session on Thursday, which gives him a good chance to play in Week 4. We should know more about his official game status sometime after practice on Friday.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jadarian Price (chest) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
news.desc: Jadarian Price (chest) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: The rookie was limited at practice to start the week on Wednesday, but he has since been downgraded and was a non-participant on Thursday. He seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 4, and fantasy managers should expect George Holani (rib) to see a lot of work if Price is unable to play on Sunday.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: George Holani (rib) limited Thursday
news.desc: George Holani (rib) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Holani was able to log another limited practice session on Thursday. It looks like he's going to play in Week 4, and he may see more work than usual with Jadarian Price (chest) trending the wrong way and Zach Charbonnet (knee) still awaiting clearance to play after recently making his return to the practice field.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) officially limited Thursday
news.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Thursday was Charbonnet's first day back on the practice field after the team recently opened his practice window. He was able to participate in a limited fashion, and it looks like he is set to return to the lineup sometime sooner rather than later. His return, whenever it comes, will mean less work for rookie Jadarian Price (chest) moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jacob Monk (quad) absent from practice Thursday
news.desc: Jacob Monk (quad) was absent from practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Green Bay is dealing with several injuries on their offensive line, including to Monk, who has yet to practice this week due to a quad issue. It looks like he's going to be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jager Burton (groin) added to injury report Thursday
news.desc: Jager Burton (groin) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.impact: Burton was a starting guard for the Packers last week, but it looks like he may be sidelined by a groin injury in Week 4. We won't know more about his status until later on in the week, however.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) limited Thursday
news.desc: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: To no surprise, the veteran was limited at another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a shoulder issue. We should get an official injury designation for him sometime after practice on Friday.
